Demonstrate technical solutions for the fastening requirements of end customers

Hands-on problem-solving engineering experience
Ability to achieve results by working with a team, even under tough circumstances

You will help customers build confidence in fastening products by working with them to understand their needs and develop proposals that fit their operations. On-site solution demonstrations at end customer facilities are a core part of how this team works together to deliver results.
cond_0423.responsibilities:
Work with end customers and internal teams to develop technical solutions for fastening requirements
Coordinate with distributors and customers on design and project activities, both in and out of production facilities
Support on-site demonstrations of technical solutions for end customers
Help ensure performance, quality, and reliability are maintained throughout the design cycle
Collaborate with relevant teams to research and resolve product integrity issues with appropriate urgency
Build and maintain engineering relationships with end customers, and support relationships with key distributor personnel
Submit reporting tools on time, including CRM data, pipeline management, and project visibility updates
Work with customers during the sales cycle using financial metrics and technical risk evaluation to support their decisions; contribute to sales project timelines, risk assessments, test methods, and implementation plans
Participate in formal and informal training opportunities and share knowledge with the team
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS in Engineering or equivalent work experience
3+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing setting
Minimum 3 years of sales experience working for a manufacturer or distributor
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
Preferred Requirements
Ability to understand and communicate technical subject matter clearly
Familiarity with air and electric powered tools used in industrial settings, including competitor products and applications
Working knowledge of multi-channel distribution functions and end user selling
cond_0423.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
